title: Fun with Fibonacci
source_topic: ICPC / The 2018 Asia Hanoi Regional Contest
source_text: The Fibonacci sequence is defined by the following recurrence relation: $F_ n = F_{n - 1} + F_{n - 2}$ , with seed values $F_0 = 0$ and $F_1 = 1$ . The first few values of the Fibonacci sequence are $0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, \ldots $ Let: $G(1, n)$ denotes the $n$ -th Fibonacci number. $G(2, n) = G(1, G(1, n))$ , $G(i, n) = G(1, G(i-1, n))$ . Calculate $G(k, n) \bmod p$ . Input The first line of input contains the only integer $T$ — the number of test cases. $(1 \le T \le 10^5)$ . Each test case consists of one line, containing $3$ integers $n$ , $k$ and $p$ , separated by single spaces. $(1 \le k, n \le 10^{18}, 1 \le p \le 10^6)$ . Output For each test case, print a single line, containing $G(k, n) \bmod p$ . Sample Input 1 Sample Output 1 10 1 1 1000000 1 2 1000000 1 3 1000000 2 1 1000000 2 2 1000000 2 3 1000000 3 1 1000000 3 2 1000000 3 3 1000000 1000000000000000000 1000000000000000000 1000000 1 1 1 1 1 1 2 1 1 890625
